protected_scopes.description: Owner-suite wake-up scheduling, alarm sync, wake-up execution, bathroom follow-up audio, snooze, cancel, and morning recovery.
Bedtime preparation, overnight goodnight integrity, owner-suite privacy, guest-aware shutdown, and owner-suite LED sleep/wake policies.
Zigbee2MQTT join, leave, offline, systemic recovery, decommission, notification, and inventory reconciliation behavior.
Arrival-time adaptive lighting correction and selected Inovelli LED-bar synchronization behavior.
Basement TV session lifecycle and guest-aware whole-house lighting response.

classified_gaps.reason: Exact media URIs and playlist composition are explicitly excluded by specs/alarm_wakeup.allium; PR #800 only removes Panic-related Spotify selections from randomized media pools without changing wake-up scheduling, playback verification, retry, fallback, or volume-ramp behavior.

Issue #801 hardens bedtime playback fallback in script.spotify_bedtime and centralizes LoFi playlist selection; wake-up scheduling, playback verification, retry, fallback, and volume-ramp behavior governed by alarm_wakeup.allium are unchanged.
Issue #772 hardens wake-up radio playback verification, retry, and fallback in script.music_assistant_radio_wake_up; bedtime and goodnight behavior governed by night_routines.allium is unchanged.
